dct_creator_sm: Skinner, Ernest Meeson (Land Title and Survey Authority of British Columbia).
dct_description_sm: Georeferenced map of Lake Babine Nation reserves Nedoats 11 and Michell Pierre 12 on Babine Lake near McKendrick Island. Land cover and features include types of soil, trees such as poplar, willow, spruce, black pine and gardens, hay, a village and timber. Surveyed by E.M. Skinner, 1898. [Signed by A.W. Vowell, Indian Reserve Commissioner, no date.] [Approved by F. Carter-Cotton, Chief Commissioner of Lands and Works, 26 February 1900.]
